## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person/Contact** — core entity; fields include: name (full name, may be business name), source, created date, last visit date, last communication date+preview, last text received date, phone number(s), tags, stage, assigned agent
- **Smart List** — saved query/filter set with a name, ID (integer in URL path), member count badge; belongs to an account; has a "segment/view" sub-filter layer
- **Tag** — many-to-many with Person; string values; used for inclusion/exclusion filters (examples: "compliance", "Unsubscribed", "Expired", "Withdrawn")
- **Stage** — enum on Person; examples implied: "Active Client" (excluded), plus various other stages
- **Agent/User** — Person can be assigned to an Agent; filter "Agent includes any of: Matt Ryan" shows agent is a FK relationship
- **Phone** — has a "good" boolean/status indicator; Person can have multiple phones; each phone may have a text-capability flag
- **Communication** — tracks last communication date and a preview snippet of the message content; type-agnostic (could be email, text, call note)
- **Text Message** — separate tracking from "last communication" (there is a distinct "Last Text Received" column)
- **Website Visit** — tracked per contact; surfaces as "Last Visit" date

### Column Categories (from Columns panel — implies field groupings in the data model):
- **Details (10 fields):** Core demographic/contact info fields
- **Assigned (2 fields):** Agent assignment fields
- **Emails (1 field):** Email-related metric columns
- **Calls (fields):** Call-related metric columns
- **Texts (1 field):** Text/SMS related metric columns
- **Website activity (5 fields):** Website engagement tracking columns
- **Deals (fields):** Transaction/deal-related data
- **Inbox Apps (fields):** Third-party integration app data
- **Custom Fields (fields):** User-defined custom attributes

### Enrichment Fields (from Columns right pane):
These are enrichment data fields FUB can surface on contacts (via a third-party enrichment provider):
- Recently Divorced (boolean or date)
- Recently Moved (boolean or date)
- Enrichment Provider (string — source of enrichment data)
- Phone Type (enum: mobile/landline/VoIP)
- Net Worth Range (enum or range string)
- Income Range (enum or range string)
- Occupation (string)
- Has Children (boolean)
- Household Size (integer or range)
- Marital Status (enum)
- Gender (enum)
- Birthday (date)

### Source Tags / Lead Sources visible in table:
- "Expired" — contact sourced from expired listing outreach
- "Expired Listing" — variant label for expired listing source
- "Import" — contact was manually imported
- "Bound Listing" — contact linked to a bound/active listing

### Filter Operators visible:
- "exclude any of" — exclusion filter (blacklist-style tag filtering)
- "include any of" — inclusion filter (whitelist-style tag filtering)
- "more than" — relative date comparison
- "excludes any of" — stage exclusion
- "is good" — boolean state check
- "includes any of" — agent assignment inclusion

### URL Structure:
- `/2/people/list/{smartListId}` — smart list detail view
- The `2` prefix may indicate account ID or version prefix

```
      <NavItem label="Manage" href="/smart-lists/manage" />
    </NavFooter>
  </LeftRail>

  <MainContent>
    <SmartListHeader
      title="All Expireds"
      onRename={() => {}}
      recordCount={24}
      onSearch={() => {}}
    >
      <HelpLink label="How Smart Lists work" href="..." />
      <ColumnsButton onClick={toggleColumnsPanel} />
      <ViewSegmentChip label="Out Of State Home ..." />
      <FiltersButton filterCount={7} onClick={toggleFiltersPanel} active />
      <UpdateListButton onClick={saveFilters} />
      <RefreshButton onClick={refresh} />
    </SmartListHeader>

    <ContactTable
      sortColumn="created"
      sortDirection="desc"
      columns={[
        { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
        { key: 'created', label: 'Created', sortable: true, active: true, direction: 'desc' },
        { key: 'lastVisit', label: 'Last Visit' },
        { key: 'lastCommunication', label: 'Last Communication', sortable: true },
        { key: 'lastTextReceived', label: 'Last Text Received' },
      ]}
    >
      {contacts.map(contact => (
        <ContactRow
          key={contact.id}
          avatar={<InitialsAvatar name={contact.name} color={contact.avatarColor} />}
          name={contact.name}
          sourceLabel={contact.source}
          created={contact.createdAt}
          lastVisit={contact.lastVisitAt}
          lastCommunication={contact.lastCommunicationAt}
          lastCommunicationPreview={contact.lastCommunicationPreview}
          lastTextReceived={contact.lastTextReceivedAt}
          phones={contact.phones}
        />
      ))}
    </ContactTable>

    <TablePagination prev={onPrev} next={onNext} />
  </MainContent>
</AppShell>

{columnsOpen && (
  <ColumnsPanel onClose={closeColumns}>
    <ColumnsCategoryList
      categories={[
        { key: 'details', label: 'Details', count: 10 },
        { key: 'assigned', label: 'Assigned', count: 2 },
        { key: 'emails', label: 'Emails', count: 1 },
        { key: 'calls', label: 'Calls' },
        { key: 'texts', label: 'Texts', count: 1 },
        { key: 'websiteActivity', label: 'Website activity', count: 5 },
        { key: 'deals', label: 'Deals' },
        { key: 'inboxApps', label: 'Inbox Apps' },
        { key: 'customFields', label: 'Custom Fields' },
      ]}
      selected={selectedCategory}
      onSelect={setSelectedCategory}
    />
    <ColumnFieldList
      fields={categoryFields[selectedCategory]}
      activeColumns={activeColumns}
      onToggle={toggleColumn}
    />
  </ColumnsPanel>
)}

{filtersOpen && (
  <FiltersPanel onClose={closeFilters}>
    <AddFilterInput onAdd={addFilter} />
    {activeFilters.map(filter => (
      <FilterChip
        key={filter.id}
        label={filter.label}
        value={filter.displayValue}
        onExpand={() => expandFilter(filter.id)}
        onRemove={() => removeFilter(filter.id)}
        expanded={filter.expanded}
      />
    ))}
    <ClearFiltersLink onClick={clearAllFilters} />
  </FiltersPanel>
)}
```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Two-layer filtering model:** Smart lists have a *base definition* (the 7 saved filters that define "All Expireds" = 431 people) and a *view segment* (the "Out Of State Home..." saved view that further narrows to 24). The "Update List" button saves changes to the base definition. The view segment is a separately-named saved filter overlay.

2. **Badge count = base list count, not view count:** The left rail shows "431" but the table shows "Showing 24 people" because a view segment is applied. The badge reflects the smart list's total membership, not the current filtered view.

3. **Columns panel counts:** The numbers in parentheses next to each category (Details (10), Assigned (2), etc.) indicate how many columns from that category are *currently active/visible* in the table — not how many total are available. This helps users know where their current column selections are distributed.

4. **Phone icon dual-state:** Green solid circle = phone validated as "good" (likely via phone validation service). The additional purple/violet circle icon likely indicates the phone is also text-capable (mobile vs. landline indicator from enrichment) or could represent a FUB dialer-specific state.

5. **"Last Communication" preview text:** The column truncates the most recent communication message body inline in the table cell. The "7 months ago" relative timestamp suggests this field auto-calculates from the stored communication date. Color coding may indicate staleness threshold (e.g., green = recent, gray/amber = stale, red = very old).

6. **Smart list "Expired" context:** The entire list exists to track expired MLS listings where homeowners whose listings expired without selling are prospected. Sources like "Expired Listing" and the tag filter "Tags include any of: Expired" confirm this is a prospecting-oriented list focused on expired/withdrawn listing leads.

7. **TCPA Litigators — Hard Stop:** A compliance-specific smart list that appears in the "SMART LISTS" section with badge 152, indicating 152 contacts flagged as TCPA litigators. The "compliance" tag exclusion filter in "All Expireds" ensures these contacts are excluded from outreach lists.

8. **"Out Of State Home" segment:** The filter segment name "Out Of State Home ..." suggests filtering for contacts who own a home out-of-state (absentee/investor profile), which is a targeted sub-segment of expired listing owners for specific outreach campaigns.

9. **Column panel counts persist:** When a category shows "(10)" in the columns panel, this dynamically reflects the user's current column configuration. Opening the panel and adding/removing a column would update this count.

10. **Pagination vs. virtual scroll:** The `< >` pagination arrows visible at bottom suggest page-based pagination rather than infinite scroll for the contact list.
